source_database_snapshot.verification_boundary: Repository state is implementation evidence. No current combined status checks or workflow runs were returned for the inspected head; deployed runtime behavior is not verified by this dataset.

non_negotiable_invariants.consequence: Shaelvien and RIST may expose different workflows but must not maintain contradictory character, campaign, or world state.
A guided view, expert dashboard, crop, zoom, angle, or simplified label never creates a second canonical identity.

non_negotiable_invariants.rule: Spatial truth remains WORLD -> REGION -> LOCAL -> INSTANCE -> ENCOUNTER.
non_negotiable_invariants.consequence: Inside-out learning begins as private prep/campaign data; canonical geometry is created only through valid parent identities and authority.

non_negotiable_invariants.rule: Draft, campaign behavior, runtime play, and world geometry remain separate data classes.
non_negotiable_invariants.consequence: A novice answer does not silently become published/canonical world truth.
Guided workflows may prepare a claim or promotion but never manufacture edit rights in Shaelvien MMO.

non_negotiable_invariants.rule: Existing working advanced tools are preserved.
non_negotiable_invariants.consequence: Progressive disclosure hides complexity; it does not delete WorldBuilder, Region, Local, Instance, Campaign, Asset, card, tracker, accessibility, or advanced controls.

non_negotiable_invariants.rule: All essential actions share one action graph across touch, mouse, keyboard, controller, speech, switch input, and accessibility surfaces.
non_negotiable_invariants.consequence: No guided or expert path may depend on precision drag, hover, or one device class.
New structural failures require a test or invariant before the feature is considered stable.

blockers.finding: ShaelvienGmGuide stores objective, scene, encounter, pressure, and consequence only in component fields.
blockers.impact: Leaving the component for play disposes the draft; the user's prep is not durable.
blockers.required_fix: Create a versioned world/account-scoped Guided GM draft model with local fallback and private authenticated persistence.

blockers.finding: RUN / PLAY routes to generic roleplay/ShaelvienMmoFront rather than a runtime session bound to the prepared situation.
blockers.impact: The displayed OBJECTIVE -> SCENE -> ENCOUNTERS -> PLAY -> CONSEQUENCE loop is not actually closed.
blockers.required_fix: Introduce a stable PrepId/SessionId handoff into a run surface and a return path to post-play consequence capture.

blockers.finding: Guided GM answers do not map to Creative Workbench, Campaign behavior, recursive spatial scopes, or a promotion record.
blockers.impact: The promise that play grows the world is currently presentation text only.
blockers.required_fix: Add explicit promotion actions from private prep -> prepared session -> play record -> accepted consequences -> campaign/world references.

blockers.finding: OPEN RIST from Shaelvien invokes the WorldGate; selecting a sandbox world currently auto-opens WorldBuilder. ENTER SHAELVIEN from RIST invokes OpenShaelvien and immediately enters roleplay.
blockers.impact: The new Shaelvien-guided versus RIST-direct launcher distinction can be bypassed during environment switching.
blockers.required_fix: Separate environment selection intent from workspace-opening intent. Environment switches return to the appropriate role-choice hub.

blockers.finding: The Shaelvien Roleplayer card describes LOOK -> BASICS -> PLAY -> GROW but routes directly to roleplay.
blockers.impact: The player learning path is not implemented.
blockers.required_fix: Create a guided character seed flow that saves appearance/basic identity first, then unlocks remaining growth through explicit play-derived choices.

blockers.finding: OPEN GM DESK routes to the Creative Workbench. The expert user still lacks one operational GM desk centered on documents, tracking, people/NPCs, world, encounters, assets, rules, and run.
blockers.impact: RIST remains partly organized by internal production concepts rather than the experienced GM's table routine.
blockers.required_fix: Create a RIST GM Desk router that surfaces existing workspaces directly without duplicating their data.

blockers.finding: The guided GM copy implies the outside world can grow directly, but Shaelvien MMO world/region/local edits require explicit authority and valid recursive parents.
blockers.impact: A novice path could imply permissions the user does not possess.
blockers.required_fix: Keep novice prep private/campaign-scoped by default. Offer world promotion only when a valid owned/authorized scope exists; otherwise offer practice/private RIST placement or a claim request.

blockers.finding: Current guidance uses party size and a qualitative pressure label but has no ruleset-specific level/power/budget adapter.
blockers.impact: It cannot truthfully claim mathematical encounter balance for arbitrary systems.
blockers.required_fix: Rename generic output to difficulty intent. Add pluggable ruleset adapters that declare required inputs and calculations.

blockers.finding: No combined status checks or workflow runs were returned for the inspected current head.
blockers.impact: Compile, test, deployment, and live interaction success are unverified.
blockers.required_fix: Make structural-plan tests, component contract tests, build, and mobile smoke verification explicit release gates.

blockers.finding: The code index reports eight error events/signatures while its configured repository error sources KNOWN_ERRORS.md and .code-index/runtime_errors.jsonl are not present at the inspected branch paths.
blockers.impact: The error count is not self-explanatory from the active tree and cannot serve as a complete live blocker feed by itself.
blockers.required_fix: Materialize or link the authoritative error ledger and runtime error stream into a discoverable governed source, without duplicating authority.

player.promise: Learn the game by becoming a character and growing through play.
player.complexity_policy: Reveal fields and tools when play creates a reason for them.

gamemaster.promise: Learn GameMastering by preparing and running one useful situation at a time.
gamemaster.complexity_policy: Ask one decision at a time; expose advanced studios only when the current task needs them.

player.promise: Design the character, enter the game, track what matters.

gamemaster.promise: Open the GM desk and work in the order the table already uses.
gamemaster.complexity_policy: No mandatory tutorial funnel; preserve shortcuts and dense controls.

core_atom.name: PlayableSituation
core_atom.purpose: The smallest complete unit that can be prepared, run, observed, and continued.

supporting_records.name: CampaignSetup
supporting_records.role: Reusable table-level facts: players, ruleset, tone, boundaries, house rules, accessibility/preferences.

supporting_records.name: EncounterPlan
supporting_records.role: Conversation, discovery, obstacle, hazard, combat, or system-specific encounter information.

supporting_records.name: RunSession
supporting_records.role: Binds one or more PlayableSituation records to actual play without changing world geometry.

supporting_records.name: PlayRecord
supporting_records.role: What actually happened during play: decisions, outcomes, discovered information, defeated/changed entities, and unresolved threads.

supporting_records.name: ConsequenceRecord
supporting_records.role: Human-reviewed statement of what became true after play.

supporting_records.name: PromotionRecord
supporting_records.role: Explicitly records movement from private draft/campaign truth into canonical world or recursive-scope truth, including authority checks and target identity.

supporting_records.name: CharacterSeed
supporting_records.role: Minimum Shaelvien player identity: appearance, name/identity, and only the initial stats required to enter play.

supporting_records.name: CharacterGrowthEvent
supporting_records.role: One earned/unlocked character choice with provenance to play or explicit GM/system grant.

truth_lifecycle.description: Safe unfinished work. Not world canon.
Ready to run. Still not world geometry.
Active session state. Observed outcomes are provisional until resolved.
What occurred is retained with provenance.
The table/GM accepts what became true for campaign continuity.
Selected facts or authored geometry are explicitly attached to stable campaign/world identities.

inside_out_growth_rules: A beginner may create a scene before knowing its final place in the canonical spatial hierarchy.
That early scene remains a PlayableSituation/private campaign object, not an orphaned canonical Instance.
When spatial placement becomes necessary, the system asks whether the scene belongs in an existing authorized Local/Region/World or needs a new authorized parent chain.
Creating a Local still requires an eligible placed Region anchor; creating an Instance still requires an eligible Local anchor/marker.
If the user lacks Shaelvien shared-world authority, the system keeps the material private, offers an appropriate claim/request path, or allows placement in an owned RIST world.
World growth is a projection of accepted play and explicit authorship; it is never inferred solely from text or visual similarity.

questions: What kind of experience does the group want?

asks: What are the players trying to accomplish?
What meaningful choices or conflicts may occur?
What reward or consequence is possible?

repeatable_session.behavior: Validate only the minimum required to run. Offer optional ruleset balance calculation when supported.
Open a run surface bound to SituationId and create RunSession.

asks: What do the players care about next?

repeatable_session.behavior: Offer only contextually valid next actions: next scene, connect people/clues, attach to existing place, request/claim space, create authorized child scope, or move to owned RIST world.

rist_gm_desk.principle: The desk is a router and status surface. It must reuse existing authoritative workspaces, not copy their data into a new dashboard database.

shaelvien.enter_condition: CharacterSeed is valid for the selected ruleset/world.
shaelvien.growth: Additional stats, powers, equipment, relationships, and specializations are unlocked or chosen through explicit CharacterGrowthEvent records.

rist.principle: Experienced/private play can expose the full sheet immediately.

adapter_mode.rule: If required inputs are missing, report that balance is unresolved rather than inventing a budget.

environment_switch: Select/load an appropriate world if required.
Return to that environment's role-choice hub.
Only a subsequent role/action choice opens a workspace.
navigation_contract.home: HOME returns to the active environment hub without changing world authority or silently switching environments.
navigation_contract.back: BACK changes presentation/history only and does not undo authored state.
navigation_contract.run_return: A run launched from a prepared SituationId can return to its AFTER step with the same persisted situation.

requirements: Narrow layouts reflow instead of hiding primary actions.
Screen reader and visual interfaces reference the same canonical state.

implementation_sequence.name: VERIFY_AND_FREEZE
implementation_sequence.goal: Keep the safety branch immutable; capture current head and blockers; add dataset validation.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Plan dataset loads and invariant test passes.

implementation_sequence.name: FOUNDATION_MODE_AND_NAVIGATION
implementation_sequence.goal: Make Shaelvien/RIST environment state and role hubs deterministic without changing deep tools.
work: Stop WorldGate from auto-opening WorldBuilder when it was opened only to choose a RIST world.
Return RIST -> Shaelvien switch to Shaelvien hub instead of roleplay.
Add regression tests for hub switching.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Phone can switch Shaelvien <-> RIST repeatedly without landing in the wrong workspace.

implementation_sequence.name: GUIDED_GM_DATA
implementation_sequence.goal: Persist the novice GM loop before adding more UI.
work: Add local + private authenticated storage following Creative Workbench precedent.
Give each draft stable IDs and world/campaign scope.
Migrate current ShaelvienGmGuide fields to the persisted model.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Refresh, Home, and workspace navigation preserve the same draft.

implementation_sequence.name: GUIDED_GM_RUN_LOOP
work: Pass SituationId into a runtime/session launcher.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: A complete preparation can be run and returned to without losing identity or content.

implementation_sequence.name: PROMOTION_AND_RECURSION
implementation_sequence.goal: Let accepted play grow campaign/world truth without violating spatial or authority contracts.
work: Attach accepted facts to Campaign behavior/notes.
Offer spatial placement only with valid parent identities.
Offer claim/request or owned RIST placement when shared Shaelvien authority is absent.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: No path can create an orphan Local/Instance or bypass permissions.

implementation_sequence.name: SHAELVIEN_PLAYER_PATH
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: A new player can enter with a minimal valid character and later add one explicit growth event at a time.

implementation_sequence.name: RIST_GM_DESK
implementation_sequence.goal: Replace the expert GM front door with an operational router/status desk.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Documents, People, Encounters, Track, World, Assets, Rules, and Run are one tap/click from the GM desk and use existing authoritative workspaces.

implementation_sequence.name: RULESET_ADAPTERS
implementation_sequence.goal: Add truthful balance calculators one ruleset at a time.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Unsupported systems remain qualitative; supported systems expose source-backed calculations.

implementation_sequence.name: HARDEN_AND_DEPLOY
implementation_sequence.goal: Regression, accessibility, device, authority, persistence, and deployment verification.
implementation_sequence.exit_gate: Automated checks plus live phone/desktop smoke tests pass before the safety branch is retired.

acceptance_tests: Shaelvien hub always offers Roleplayer and GameMaster before opening a deep workspace.
RIST hub always offers direct Player and GameMaster paths after an owned/private world is selected.
Environment switching never implicitly enters Roleplay or WorldBuilder.
Guided GM draft survives refresh and Home.
RUN preserves SituationId and returns to AFTER.
Consequence capture never silently writes canonical world geometry.
Unauthorized Shaelvien users cannot promote geometry into protected shared scopes.
Local and Instance creation still obey canonical parent-anchor requirements.
RIST GM Desk reuses existing workspaces rather than duplicating their truth.
Shaelvien player minimal character can enter play without exposing the entire advanced sheet.
All primary actions are usable by touch and keyboard with visible focus and >=44px practical targets.
No build is called verified until compile/tests/deployment and live runtime are separately checked.

external_research_validation.source: D&D Beyond — Starting Strong at Your First Dungeons & Dragons Game as Dungeon Master
external_research_validation.supports: New DMs benefit from simple scenarios, character focus, meaningful choices, problems to solve, and not needing every rule first.

external_research_validation.source: D&D Beyond — 2024 Basic Rules, Preparing a Session
external_research_validation.supports: Session prep prioritizes likely encounters, maps, NPC goals/tactics, clues, and player motivations with bounded preparation.

external_research_validation.source: Sly Flourish — Using the Lazy DM's Eight Steps At the Table
external_research_validation.supports: Experienced prep is component-based and intended to support improvisation: characters, strong start, scenes, secrets/clues, locations, NPCs, monsters, rewards.

external_research_validation.source: Sly Flourish — Thinking Two Horizons Out
external_research_validation.supports: Spiral campaign development builds around where characters are now and expands outward as needed.

build_rule: Do not add more launcher concepts until Phase 1 and Phase 2 data/navigation foundations are complete. The shell is presentation; persistence, identity, authority, and return paths come first.
